decisions.reason: The hiring outcome is already represented by the candidate's same-message runtime verification; assigning Javed as Lead Clipper does not change the qualification method or criteria.
The Lead Clipper assignment does not change the moment-selection standard, and the source's positive assessment is already represented by the candidate's same-message runtime verification.
The caption-color instruction is independently represented in this candidate's same-message events; the Lead Clipper role assignment adds no further caption-style change.
The 30–90-second duration rule is independently represented in this candidate's same-message events; the Lead Clipper assignment does not alter that rule.
Assigning Javed to create and approve clips does not change which source content is permitted.
The Lead Clipper assignment and general responsibility for standards do not modify the existing clean-editing requirement.
The responsibility to approve other clippers' work does not specify a new submission channel or replace the existing project-chat sample-review workflow.
